clues.text: Followers of Jesus in this city were the first ever to be called Christians.
When the Jerusalem church heard that many people here had turned to the Lord, they sent Barnabas.
Barnabas went to Tarsus to find Saul and brought him back here to teach for a full year.
The prophet Agabus came here from Jerusalem and foretold a great famine across the whole world.
As prophets and teachers here worshiped and fasted, the Holy Spirit said to set apart Barnabas and Saul.
Paul opposed Cephas to his face here when Cephas drew back from eating with the Gentiles.
Judas and Silas brought the Jerusalem apostles' letter to this city, and the people rejoiced.
